description: This file contains functions related to executing system commands within a specified context, including creating execution contexts that run commands as a specified user and executing commands while capturing their output.

methods.name: NewAsUserExecContext
methods.description: Creates an execution context that runs commands as a specified user using 'sudo'. If the user parameter is nil, it returns the original execution context.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command within a given execution context, capturing standard output and including standard error in the error message if execution fails.
